candidates.tagline: Ferrari paid the Magic Mouse guy to design their $640K EV. Go figure.
candidates.story: Ferrari's first electric car, the Luce, was co-designed by former Apple design chief Jony Ive at a price of $640,000 — and went instantly viral when the internet noticed the car's underside looks exactly like an Apple Magic Mouse plugged in with a Lightning cable.
candidates.why_funny: Ferrari insisted the Luce 'isn't an electric car, it's a Ferrari that happens to be electric' — then hired the guy who made everything look like Apple products and got a car that looks like an Apple product.
candidates.alt: Side-by-side meme image showing the Ferrari Luce EV seen from below next to an Apple Magic Mouse also flipped upside-down; the resemblance is striking — both have a similarly shaped white underbody with a port in the center

candidates.tagline: Your AI soulmate ships July 2026 — it just stares at you from your desk.
candidates.story: Lepro's 'Ami' — an always-on desktop device with dual cameras, eye-tracking, and AR marketed as an AI 'soulmate' for remote workers — was voted the People's Choice Worst in Show at CES 2026 and is now hitting shelves in July 2026.
candidates.why_funny: They built a surveillance camera that watches you all day, called it your romantic companion, and the public immediately voted it the single worst product at the world's biggest tech show.
candidates.alt: The Lepro Ami device on the CES 2026 show floor: a compact standing curved OLED display showing an animated AI avatar face, surrounded by trade show visitors
candidates.credit: iFixit / Repair.org — Worst in Show CES 2026
